lines: Applications are invited for Summer Undergraduate Research Exposure (SURE) Internships 2025
Total: 250 interns (100 exclusive for girls only).
Rs. 7,500 per month per intern or Rs. 10,000 for one-and-a-half months per intern.
Interns can choose one option: one month duration, one and a half month duration, or complete two months duration.
No other amount/benefit shall be applicable.
1-2 months between May and July (Tentative: 15.05.2025 to 14.07.2025).
Minimum of one month and maximum of two months only.
Hostel accommodation provided in IITH student hostels.
Mess charges to be borne by the interns.
ONLY NON-IIT HYDERABAD STUDENTS with the following criteria:

A. Should be a first year MSc (Maths/Physics/Chemistry/Biology) OR MA first Year OR MA Psychology 1st/2nd Year OR MSc Psychology 1st/2nd Year OR MRes Psychology 1st/2nd Year OR the 2nd/3rd Year B.Tech/ B.Des/B.Arch/B.A(All branches) OR the 3rd/4th Year Integrated B.Tech.-M.Tech. program.

B. Applicants should be among the top 20% based on CGPA/% score in all the previous years in their discipline in the College/ Institution/University (certified by the Head of the Institute/Principal).
C. The applicant should be a full-time/regular student at the time of application and till the completion of the internship.
D. The applicant should be able to work full time (minimum one month) for the Internship. Part-time/online internship is not allowed.
Applications must be submitted through the web portal only.
Offline applications and applications through emails shall not be entertained.
After the deadline, no applications shall be accepted.
a. Preliminary screening of applications followed by an interview (online mode) department/mentor faculty wise.
b. Selection based on academic performance, participation/recognition in competitions such as Olympiads, National Talent Search Exams, and performance in the interview.
Last date for submission of online form
Selected candidates shall be informed through emails only.
The final list of selected interns shall also be displayed on the SRC Office webpage under the News/Announcement section.
No separate communication shall be sent to non-selected candidates.
The decision of IIT Hyderabad authorities shall be final in the selection of candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria.
No correspondence shall be entertained in this regard.
